verdict.rationale: Base44 documents iterative prompting where AI updates code, styles and components from natural-language follow-ups. It shows design previews before it touches anything, offers a testing agent that runs browser tests on key flows, and supports GitHub version control. Community users report that AI fixes and cross-app changes work well. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-editor version history or rollback after a bad prompt, any guarantee that edits stay scoped and do not regress existing features, and independent hands-on evidence of multi-step refinement without breakage.
